title: Senior Job Bidder — Part-Time Contract
summary: In2AI delivers AI-enabled software development, automation, and digital solutions to clients. We work with distributed teams across industries, with an emphasis on identifying the right projects, preparing strong proposals, and building long-term client relationships. As Senior Job Bidder, you will manage the bidding process from opportunity discovery through proposal submission and initial client engagement. You should understand technology and software-development projects well enough to evaluate requirements, decide whether an opportunity is a good fit, and write customized proposals rather than generic templates. This is a remote, results-oriented contract: about 5–8 hours per day during U.S. business hours, with flexibility as long as coverage, responsiveness, and performance are maintained.
responsibilitySummary: Identify marketplace opportunities, write customized technology proposals, and build a qualified project pipeline
responsibilities: Research and identify relevant software development, AI, automation, web, mobile, cloud, and related technology opportunities on approved freelance and project marketplaces
Review job descriptions and client requirements before bidding to determine technical and commercial fit
Prepare customized, professional proposals based on each client's specific requirements
Submit bids using approved In2AI accounts, processes, templates, and positioning
Maintain a consistent daily bidding pipeline while prioritizing quality and relevance
Communicate with prospective clients professionally and respond promptly to initial questions
Coordinate with technical team members when estimates, architecture discussions, technical clarification, or specialized expertise are required
Maintain accurate records of submitted bids, client responses, interviews, follow-ups, and project outcomes
Follow up on promising opportunities and help move qualified prospects toward meetings and project discussions
Analyze bid performance, including response and interview rates, and continuously improve bidding strategies
Mentor or provide bidding guidance to junior bidders when required
Protect company credentials, client information, pricing information, proposal materials, and other confidential information
mustHave: Approximately 2+ years in online job bidding, business development, lead generation, proposal writing, or technology sales, preferably involving software or IT projects
Strong written English and the ability to communicate naturally with North American clients
Comfort discussing web and mobile development, AI/ML, cloud services, APIs, SaaS, automation, and software engineering
Ability to work independently, manage multiple opportunities at once, and operate in a performance-driven remote environment
A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a professional environment suitable for client communication
Availability aligned primarily with U.S. business hours; exact coverage hours agreed with the Manager
preferred: Examples of successful technology proposals or measurable bidding results
Familiarity with approved freelance and project marketplaces
benefits: 100% remote work from a global or other approved location
Flexible scheduling within agreed U.S. coverage hours
Initial three-month engagement with the possibility of extension
Ownership of In2AI’s bidding and client-acquisition process
workingHours: Approximately 5–8 hours per day, aligned with U.S. business hours
contractTerm: Initial 3-month contract, with potential extension based on performance and business needs
compensationNote: A qualified bid must comply with company bidding standards, match the targeted opportunity criteria, be customized for the client, and be recorded in the company tracking system. Duplicate, irrelevant, misleading, or non-compliant bids may not count. Currency, measurement period, and calculation method are specified in the contractor agreement.
performanceExpectations: Evaluated on bid quality, client response rate, interview and conversation generation, relevance of targeted opportunities, tracking accuracy, communication quality, and contribution to project acquisition — not volume alone
Exercise judgment about which opportunities are worth pursuing rather than focusing exclusively on submission volume
applyHint: Submit your resume together with a short summary of your previous bidding or business-development experience and, where available, examples of successful technology proposals or measurable bidding results.
